why:
Each needs a Stanza dependency model for its language, roughly two gigabytes in total, and multilingual parsing is not in the declared scope. They are the same two-cadence sentence as the English case — if the layer generalises at all, it generalises here — so they are kept as evidence of what was intended rather than deleted. Move them back into build_cases.py when multilingual is in scope and the models are fetched.

The multilingual normalisation cases are NOT here. Those run today, because `normalize` needs no model.
